references.text: The Lord's hand was against them to wipe them out from the camp until they were gone. Same theme of God bringing confusion and destruction upon enemies.
God sends His terror ahead of Israel and brings confusion over all the peoples they meet. Same promise of divine intervention against enemies.
The Lord brought confusion over the Egyptian army. The same Hebrew word 'mehuma' (confusion) is used for God's intervention against enemies.
The Lord threw them into confusion before Israel. Fulfillment of the promise that God would confuse Israel's enemies.
The Lord thundered with a mighty roar over the Philistines and threw them into confusion. Same pattern of divine confusion of enemies.
There was great confusion in the enemy camp. God brought chaos among the Philistines so that they struck each other down.
Earlier verses in the same chapter about God handing the peoples over to Israel so that they may strike them.
The Lord your God goes before you like a consuming fire. He will destroy them and subdue them for you.
